name: Cybershop ship
description: Cybershop ships were starships that acted as mobile cybernetics showrooms, installation, and maintenance facilities. Cybershop ships with legal cybernetics masters offered services from basic cybernetic prosthetics to advanced post-injury reconstruction and enhancement and were renowned in those areas. Some unscrupulous crafters offered illegal or illicit modifications, cutting-edge cybernetics with blatantly criminal utility, such as concealed weapons or lock-picking tools, that legal ships avoided installing—or at least advertising.

data.name: Cybershop ship
armament: Dorsal turret-mounted twin medium turbolaser battery (1)
Ventral turret-mounted twin medium turbolaser battery (1)
